pack: Last 5 Year Top 50 One Word Substitutions
title: Last 5 Year Top 50 OWS: Set 1 (Q1 to Q25)
subtitle: Ichthyologist to Ablution

words.hindi: मछलियों के बारे में वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन करने वाला व्यक्ति
words.meaning: A person who studies fish scientifically.
words.example: The ichthyologist studied rare freshwater fish species in the aquarium.

words.hindi: अनिद्रा रोगी (जिसे नींद नहीं आती)
words.meaning: A person who is unable to sleep properly.
words.example: Being an insomniac, he often reads books late into the night.

words.hindi: मानव विज्ञानी (इंसानों के रहन-सहन, रीति-रिवाज और समाज का अध्ययन करने वाला)
words.meaning: A person who studies the customs, beliefs and social relationships of human societies.
words.example: The anthropologist lived with tribal communities to document their traditions.

words.hindi: मुद्राशास्त्री (सिक्कों, मेडल और मुद्रा का संग्रह या अध्ययन करने वाला)
words.meaning: A person who collects or studies coins, medals and currency.
words.example: The numismatist examined ancient Mughal and Gupta period coins.

words.hindi: विवाह-द्वेषी (शादी की संस्था से नफ़रत या विरोध करने वाला व्यक्ति)
words.meaning: A person who is opposed to the institution of marriage.
words.example: As a confirmed misogamist, he refused every marriage proposal.

words.hindi: पाँच पंक्तियों की मज़ेदार कविता (AABBA तुकबंदी वाली)
words.meaning: A humorous five-line poem generally following the rhyme scheme AABBA.
words.example: The comedian recited a witty limerick that made the entire hall laugh.

words.hindi: विदाई भाषण (किसी की विदाई के मौके पर दिया जाने वाला भाषण)
words.meaning: A speech delivered on the occasion of someone's departure or farewell.
words.example: The retiring principal gave an emotional valediction at the farewell ceremony.

words.hindi: धर्मोपदेश (धर्म और नैतिक बातें सिखाने के लिए दिया जाने वाला उपदेश)
words.meaning: A religious discourse delivered by a priest or preacher to instruct people on moral and spiritual matters.
words.example: The saint delivered a peaceful sermon on kindness and truth.

words.hindi: शव को सड़ने से बचाने के लिए विशेष रसायन (केमिकल) लगाना
words.meaning: The process of preserving a dead body by treating it with special chemicals.
words.example: Doctors embalmed the body before transporting it abroad for burial.

words.hindi: पति की हत्या (अपनी पत्नी द्वारा पति की हत्या)
words.meaning: The killing of one's own husband.
words.example: The court sentenced the accused for the crime of mariticide.

words.hindi: भ्रूण हत्या (गर्भ में पल रहे अजन्मे बच्चे की हत्या)
words.meaning: The act of causing the death of an unborn baby in the womb.
words.example: Female foeticide is a punishable crime under Indian law.

words.hindi: शिशु रोग विशेषज्ञ (बच्चों का इलाज करने वाला डॉक्टर)
words.meaning: A doctor who treats children.
words.example: Parents should consult a qualified paediatrician for child healthcare.

words.hindi: किसी वास्तविक व्यक्ति या घटना से जुड़ा छोटा रोचक किस्सा
words.meaning: A short interesting story about a real person or event.
words.example: He entertained his friends with a funny anecdote from his school days.

words.hindi: सबसे अयोग्य या भ्रष्ट लोगों का शासन
words.meaning: A form of government in which the least qualified or most unscrupulous people are in power.
words.example: When unqualified leaders take over, democracy turns into a kakistocracy.

words.hindi: धर्मतंत्र (ऐसी सरकार जिसमें धार्मिक नेता शासन करते हैं)
words.meaning: A form of government in which religious leaders exercise political authority.
words.example: In a theocracy, state laws are based directly on religious scriptures.

words.hindi: राजगद्दी त्याग (राजा या रानी द्वारा स्वेच्छा से सिंहासन छोड़ना)
words.meaning: The formal act of a king or queen voluntarily giving up the throne.
words.example: Chandragupta Maurya's abdication placed Bindusara on the throne.

words.hindi: मानवीकरण (जानवरों, वस्तुओं या देवताओं को इंसानों जैसी भावनाएँ और गुण देना)
words.meaning: The attribution of human emotions, characteristics or behaviour to animals, objects or supernatural beings.
words.example: Cartoon movies use anthropomorphism by making animals talk and wear clothes.

words.hindi: पवनवेगमापी (हवा की रफ़्तार मापने वाला यंत्र)
words.meaning: An instrument used by meteorologists to measure the speed of wind.
words.example: The weather station uses an anemometer to track cyclone wind speeds.

words.hindi: बिल (खरगोश या लोमड़ी द्वारा ज़मीन में खोदी गई सुरंग)
words.meaning: A hole or tunnel dug in the ground by a small animal, such as a rabbit or fox, for shelter.
words.example: The frightened rabbit quickly ran back into its underground burrow.

words.hindi: छोटा गाँव या कुछ घरों की छोटी बस्ती
words.meaning: A small settlement in the countryside, usually smaller than a village.
words.example: He grew up in a quiet Himalayan hamlet surrounded by pine trees.

words.hindi: कंगारू का बच्चा
words.meaning: The young one of a kangaroo.
words.example: The baby joey stayed safely inside its mother's pouch.

words.hindi: फुर्ती (तेज़ी से चलने और तुरंत दिशा बदलने की क्षमता)
words.meaning: The ability to move quickly and easily while changing direction with speed and coordination.
words.example: Sprinters require both speed and agility on the athletic track.

words.hindi: बेहतर प्रदर्शन करके किसी से आगे निकल जाना
words.meaning: To be more successful or do better than someone.
words.example: She studied extra hours to outdo her previous mock test score.

words.hindi: सीढ़ी का डंडा या पायदान
words.meaning: One of the horizontal bars or steps of a ladder.
words.example: Hold tightly while stepping onto the top rung of the ladder.

words.hindi: धार्मिक शुद्धि स्नान / वुज़ू (पूजा से पहले खुद को पानी से साफ़ करना)
words.meaning: The act of washing oneself, especially as part of a religious ritual.
words.example: Devotees performed morning ablution before entering the temple.
